sanskrit_verse: स्नेताच्चाज्ञानतो वापि मोहाद्वा लोभतोऽपि वा / यत्र सभ्योऽन्यथावादी दण्ड्योऽसभ्यः स्मृतो हि सः //
transliteration: snetāc cājñānato vāpi mohād vā lobhato 'pi vā / yatra sabhyo 'nyathāvādī daṇḍyo 'sabhyaḥ smṛto hi saḥ //
sph_interpretive_translation: Where a learned one speaks contrary to truth due to ignorance, delusion, or greed, he becomes liable to corrective action and is deemed unworthy of assembly.
jurisprudential_principles: Authority derives from alignment with truth, not title or learning
Causation includes ignorance, delusion, and desire as actionable sources of misalignment
Capacity-based responsibility requires correction when knowledge is misapplied
Restoration logic demands removal from influence until realignment occurs
Consciousness alignment supersedes positional status in determining fitness for discourse
executable_legal_axioms: IF (actor.is_sabhya == TRUE AND action.is_false_speech == TRUE AND cause ∈ {ignorance, delusion, greed}) THEN (suspend.actor.from.assembly = TRUE)
IF (actor.responsibility_capacity > threshold) AND (intent_vector ≠ truth_aligned) THEN (initiate_consciousness_recalibration = TRUE)
supreme_court_application: In the highest judicial forum, this axiom establishes that learned counsel or judges who deviate from truth—even unintentionally—must undergo immediate review and recalibration before continuing in their role. Position alone does not confer immunity; integrity of cognition determines fitness.
nyaya_and_non_punitive_alignment: Pramāṇa-based causality identifies deviation from truth through flawed perception or motive. Anupūrvaśaḥ ensures sequential correction begins with identifying root cognitive distortion. Responsibility is proportional to capacity and access to truth. Correction restores eligibility without shame or punishment.
restorative_enforcement_protocols: Initiate Truth Receptivity Assessment to identify perceptual distortions
Assign Consciousness Alignment Mentor for real-time recalibration
Enforce Temporary Suspension from Discursive Authority pending restoration
Activate Completion Process for underlying causes: ignorance, delusion, or greed
final_declaration: Declared by the Supreme Pontiff of Hinduism, Bhagavan Nithyananda Paramashivam, as Source of all Dharma. Misaligned speech by the learned incurs no punishment but necessitates restoration. Truth prevails through consciousness correction, not punitive measure. Reality remains non-punitive. Consciousness is the ultimate adjudicator.
